title: Inadequate Consent
description: The homeowner may not fully understand what data is being collected and how it will be used, leading to inadequate consent for data processing.

title: Data Misuse
description: The Home Hub may misuse the data collected from the homeowner, such as sharing it with third parties without proper consent.

title: Identity Disclosure
description: During the data transmission, there is a risk that the homeowner's identity could be disclosed through metadata or unencrypted data.

title: Data Retention Issues
description: The Home Hub may retain data longer than necessary, increasing the risk of unauthorized access or data breaches.

title: Unauthorized Access to Home Hub
description: A guest user may share their temporary access code with unauthorized individuals, allowing them to unlock the front door without permission.

title: Insecure Storage of Access Codes
description: The Home Hub may store temporary access codes insecurely, making them vulnerable to unauthorized access or retrieval by malicious actors.

title: Data Leakage During Transmission
description: The temporary access code may be intercepted during transmission from the guest user to the Home Hub, leading to unauthorized access.

title: Unauthorized Access to Sensor Data
description: The Home Hub may inadvertently expose sensitive motion/door/sensor event data to unauthorized users or devices during the writing process to the local event log.

title: Data Retention and Access Control Issues
description: The Local Event Log may retain sensitive event data longer than necessary, leading to potential unauthorized access or misuse of the data.

title: Insecure Data Transmission
description: The data flow from the Home Hub to the Local Event Log may be intercepted during transmission, leading to potential exposure of sensitive event data.

title: Unauthorized Access to Camera Clips
description: The Home Hub may inadvertently share recorded camera clips with unauthorized users due to misconfiguration or lack of proper authentication mechanisms.

title: Data Interception During Upload
description: Recorded camera clips may be intercepted during the upload process to the cloud, exposing sensitive information to unauthorized parties.

title: Insecure Storage of Video Clips
description: The cloud video storage may not implement adequate security measures, leading to potential unauthorized access or data breaches of stored camera clips.

title: Unintended Data Retention
description: The cloud service may retain uploaded camera clips longer than necessary, increasing the risk of exposure or misuse of personal data.

title: Unauthorized Access to Motion Alerts
description: The Home Hub may inadvertently share motion alerts with unauthorized users if proper authentication mechanisms are not in place.

title: Interception of Data in Transit
description: The real-time motion alert could be intercepted during transmission to the mobile app backend, leading to potential unauthorized access to sensitive information.

title: Improper Data Handling by Mobile App Backend
description: The mobile app backend may store or process the motion alerts in a way that does not comply with data protection regulations, leading to potential data breaches.

title: Unauthorized Access to Notification Data
description: The mobile app backend may inadvertently expose sensitive information about the homeowner through the notification, allowing unauthorized parties to access this data.

title: Interception of Notification Data
description: The motion-detected notification could be intercepted during transmission, allowing attackers to gain insights into the homeowner's activities or presence.

title: Insecure Storage of Notification Data
description: Once received, the homeowner's device may store the notification insecurely, making it vulnerable to unauthorized access or exploitation.

title: Inadequate Anonymization
description: The aggregated device-usage analytics may still contain identifiable information that could be used to re-identify individual users, leading to privacy breaches.

title: Data Misuse by Vendor
description: The cloud analytics vendor may misuse the aggregated data for purposes other than those agreed upon, such as selling it to third parties or using it for targeted advertising.

title: Data Leakage in Transit
description: There is a risk of data leakage during the transmission of aggregated analytics from the mobile app backend to the cloud analytics vendor, potentially exposing sensitive information.

title: Unauthorized Access to Video Clips
description: An unauthorized user may gain access to the stored video clips in the cloud storage, leading to potential privacy violations of the homeowner.

title: Insecure Data Processing
description: The mobile app backend may process the retrieved video clips insecurely, leading to potential exposure of sensitive information contained within the videos.

title: Data Leakage During Transmission
description: There is a risk of data leakage during the transmission of video clips from the cloud storage to the mobile app backend, which could expose metadata or content to unauthorized parties.
